head.h1: Kids' Birthday Catering in Dubai — Prices, Formats and What You Get

opening_paragraph: Kids' birthday catering in Dubai from myCHEF costs from AED 90 per person dropped off, AED 120 for a buffet, and AED 700 with a chef cooking on site. Each booking comes with a vetted private chef who plans a colourful, allergy-aware menu, cooks on site, serves the children and clears everything away. You give us the date, the number of children and adults, the venue and the theme; we build the menu around fussy eaters and dietary needs, plate it so it photographs well, and hand you a full itemised quote — promptly during our published business hours. That leaves you free to run the party, cut the cake and be present, instead of refilling platters in the kitchen.

What's included in kids' birthday catering?

Everything on the food side is handled: a vetted chef, service staff where needed, plating, setup and full cleanup, plus a separate adult spread when you want one. You approve the menu and enjoy the party.
Can you cater allergy-aware and nut-free kids' menus?

Allergy-aware planning is standard: we collect every allergy on the guest list and design around it. Menus without intentionally added nuts may be available on request. However, partner kitchens may handle nuts and other allergens, so cross-contact cannot be excluded unless specifically confirmed for your booking. Gluten-free and dairy-free options are available on request, subject to partner confirmation and an allergen review, with clear labelling on every platter.
Do you offer affordable kids' birthday catering packages?

Yes. Drop-off from AED 90 per person and buffet from AED 120 are our lowest per-head formats, and set catering packages run from AED 1,200 to AED 5,500 for larger celebrations. Every option is quoted transparently with no hidden per-head extras.
Where in Dubai do you provide kids' birthday catering near me?

Everywhere in Dubai. The chef and equipment travel to your home, villa, apartment or venue — Palm Jumeirah, Arabian Ranches, Downtown, Dubai Marina and beyond — so a search for catering near me reaches you wherever the party is.
Can a private chef come to my home or villa?
Yes. MyCHEF is a home catering service first: a private chef cooks fresh on site at your home or villa, serves the children and adults, and cleans up, so the celebration happens in your own space.
How far ahead should I book?

As guidance: 72 hours for a standard birthday catering package, 3–5 days where live stations or a multi-staff setup are involved, 5–7 days for bespoke menus and larger private events. We recommend booking as early as possible. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu complexity, staffing, equipment, location and partner availability. A kids birthday at short notice is sometimes workable - availability is confirmed individually, never assumed.
For kids birthday catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Finger food and small parties — the format most birthdays call for
new_paragraphs: Children do not sit down to eat at a party. They graze between games, come back three times for the same slider, then abandon the plate somewhere nobody will ever find it. So finger food catering in Dubai is usually the right call for a birthday, ahead of anything plated: everything is built to be picked up in one hand and eaten while walking. Mini sliders, chicken tenders, cheese and cucumber skewers, mac-and-cheese cups, cocktail-sized pizzas, fruit on sticks, and bento boxes that survive being carried across a garden. Adults get the same idea at a different register — canapés, a grazing board, filled brioche and dips — so the two tables read as one party, not a children's spread with the leftovers pushed to the side. On small party catering in Dubai the practical floor is 10 guests for drop-off and volume formats, 20 for a full maintained buffet, and a minimum order value of AED 900. Below that a private chef, priced per head, is usually the better booking: there is no headcount minimum on a chef, so a birthday tea for six children and four parents is a normal job, not an awkward one.

add_block.new_heading: How to choose the best kids' birthday catering in Dubai
new_paragraphs: Four questions separate the best kids birthday catering in Dubai from whatever happens to be free on your date. First, who is cooking, and are they on site? A caterer who leaves cold trays at the door cannot fix anything once forty children arrive early. Second, how are allergies handled — from a written list collected before the day, or from a reassuring answer on the phone? Ask what the kitchen can and cannot control, and be suspicious of anyone who answers without qualification. Third, is the price itemised? A single per-head number with no split between food, staffing and equipment is where the surprises live. Fourth, does the timing bend to the party, or does the party bend to the caterer? Food that lands during pass-the-parcel goes cold, and cold food at a children's party is not recoverable. MyCHEF answers all four inside the quote, before you commit to anything.

Volume formats carry a 10-guest minimum, 20 for a full buffet, and a minimum order value of AED 900; a private chef has no headcount minimum.
